release_read.basis: Profit line crushed the guide (non-GAAP op income $31.2m vs $20-24m guide, diluted non-GAAP EPS $0.17 vs $0.11-0.13), FY raised to $744-748m revenue and $0.61-0.63 EPS (from $732-746m / $0.50-0.54) with Q4 guided $198-202m above the ~$192-200m the old FY implied; revenue beat is only ~1% over consensus and RPO fell again sequentially ($334m vs $340.9m) with top-10 concentration up to 39%, which caps it well inside the 18% implied move after a 22% run-in fall.

release.headline: Fastly Reports Record Third Quarter Revenue And Profit
